text.p: Here are the highlights from Swiss
- The Foreign Policy Commission of the upper house of parliament said globalisation of economy and trade should be viewed as a chance for Switzerland as an export-oriented
- Swiss Federal Attorney Clara del Ponte confirmed on Sunday a report published by the newspaper SonntagsBlick accusing her of taping the phone calls of several Swiss jounalists.

- Austrian chancellor Viktor Klima, due to make an official visit to Berne today, said he would not accept special treatment of Switzerland with regard to the bilateral Alpine crossing traffic policy between the European Union and Switzerland.
- The majority of the Swiss citizens approve the creation of a Holocaust memorial fund, accoring to an opinion poll published by Swiss daily 'Le Matin'.
